This site is maintained by the Jornada Information Management (IM) team to support researchers and data managers working with data from the [Jornada Basin LTER (JRN)]({{< var url.jrn_website >}}) and [Jornada Experimental Range (JER)]({{< var url.jer_website >}}) programs. There are two main guides here to serve two audiences:

[**The Researcher Guide**](docs/researcher/introduction.qmd) is for Jornada students, investigators, and others who need to  

- [Start new research at the Jornada](docs/researcher/starting-research.qmd)
- Collect and manage [data](docs/researcher/collecting-data.qmd) or [metadata](docs/researcher/metadata.qmd)
- [Prepare and publish a dataset](docs/researcher/prepare-and-publish.qmd)
- [Find](docs/researcher/discover-data.qmd) or [work with](docs/researcher/data-work.qmd) Jornada data
:::
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-6}

[**The IM Guide**](docs/im/introduction.qmd) is for Jornada data managers who need to

- [Check the status of a dataset](docs/im/introduction.qmd#dataset-tracking)
- [Find data management resources](docs/im/introduction.qmd#data-management-resources)
- [Prepare an annual report](docs/project-procedures/reporting.qmd)
- Read the [full IM system documentation](docs/im/sysadmin/index.qmd)

### Some other quick links

- Looking for a **research notification form** or **metadata template**? [Check here!](downloads/index.qmd)
- Did you attend, or are you attending, a data training event? Find resources at the [training site](https://jornada-im.github.io/jeds).
- Need more advice or help? Visit the IM team at [Data Therapy Thursday]({{< var url.datatherapy >}}), or check [these resources](docs/refs-and-links.qmd).

::: {.callout-caution collapse="false" appearance="default"}
## WARNING! This site is a work in progress
We try our best to keep this up-to-date and accurate, but sometimes we fall behind or miss things. Report problems and suggest additions in the [issue tracker](https://github.com/jornada-im/jornada-im.github.io/issues).

If you see a construction symbol (:construction:) we're still working on that part!

:::

### Contact us

For questions about collecting, analyzing, publishing, and accessing Jornada data or metadata please contact the IM team ({{< var email.jrn_im >}}).
